components.name: Hive Swarm Launcher
components.blurb: A rack of hungry drones. Many hands make it fast; one hand makes it sad.
components.quirk: Six tiny homing drones a salvo (+50% damage a second over the Artemis) but it fires at 0.4 the rate unless 3 crew stand in its room: Kett work in threes.

components.name: Chitin Thrower
components.blurb: Throws shed plate in a cone. It takes two to feed it, and no Kett has ever wished to be fewer.
components.quirk: A wide cone of chitin needles that splinter into the next cell, but it fires at half rate unless 2 crew stand in its room.

components.name: Drone Picket
components.blurb: Two crewmates, one watchful drone. The hive keeps its pickets in pairs.
components.quirk: A twin-drone turret that hits 30% harder than a Mk2 pulse turret and shoots down enemy missiles within 300 px before it looks at any ship, but it fires at half rate unless 2 crew stand in its room.

components.name: Hive Battery
components.blurb: A shield grown in cells, one cell to a crewmate. Three in the room and it blooms; fewer and it sulks.
components.quirk: Three layers while 3 crew stand in its room, one otherwise: Kett swarm it.

components.name: Nest Reactor
components.blurb: A reactor that likes company. It warms to the hum of the hive and sulks at an empty room.
components.quirk: +1 power for each Kett in its room, up to +3, on a base of 7: with nobody home it is weaker than a Reactor Mk1.

components.name: Brood Hold
components.blurb: A warm, crowded cell where the hive tends its own. Everyone else feels like an intruder, and works like one.
components.quirk: Kett in its room repair, patch and put fires out 20% faster, everyone else 20% slower.
